description: Send ONE TEST EMAIL of a Klaviyo template to up to 5 addresses the user names (never to a list), so they can see it in a real inbox. Without confirm:true nothing is sent and you get the preview; call again with confirm:true after they say yes. Klaviyo allows 100 test sends a day. Free. Needs Klaviyo connected (Connectors > Klaviyo, or connect_connector with a private API key).
name: send_klaviyo_test_email
title: Send a Klaviyo test email
